title: Determination 45/1/237: garage conversion and single-storey extension near trees (Requirement A2)
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 2000 (as amended): Requirement A2 (ground movement)

facts.text: The existing building is described as a two-storey semi-detached house built in the 1930s with a single-storey attached garage; the works convert the garage and add a single-storey extension to habitable accommodation.
The submission states the accommodation is needed to provide accessible ground-storey accommodation including a shower room and WC.
The applicant relies on arguments about the trees and foundations and refers to the Zurich Technical Manual to support compliance with Requirement A2 'if applicable'.
The Council questioned calculation sheet DR/04 from the applicant's structural engineer, which advised a 3m foundation depth under NHBC Chapter 4.2 assuming the oak tree's mature height.
Determination: the plans do not comply with Requirement A2 (Ground Movement) of Schedule 1 to the Building Regulations 2000 (as amended).
